👇 …

⛲🌳🍀🍃 Urban park, mawned grassland, in disturbed nutrient-rich soil

ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills close to moderately spaced; pale grey when young, becoming purplish-grey to dark grey-brown or nearly black with maturity; edges often whitish

ℹ️ Stipe: Short, cylindrical, white to cream, sometimes yellowish below; smooth to finely fibrillose; base slightly tapered with white mycelial threads; membranous white ring persistent to fragile, characteristically grooved above and darkened by deposited spores
🟣🟤⚫ Spore print dark purple-brown to blackish

🔤 Golden-yellow grassland stropharioid with a grooved ring and dark purple-brown spores
